description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'PoliciesAclMigrations' containing methods for migrating AccessControlList (ACL) objects into Policy objects within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for transforming ACL entries into policies with appropriate permission labels, handling subject identifiers, and managing permissions related to policies, things, and messages.

classes.name: PoliciesAclMigrations
classes.description: Utility class for migrating ACLs to Policies within the Eclipse Ditto framework. Contains constants and static methods to facilitate permission translation and policy creation from ACL entries.

methods.name: accessControlListToPolicyEntries
methods.description: Converts an AccessControlList to a Policy object, mapping ACL entries to policy labels with appropriate permissions based on ACL permissions and subject issuers.

methods.name: getSubjectWithoutIssuer
methods.description: Extracts the subject id from an ACL entry's authorization subject, removing any issuer prefix if present.
